playstyle.identity: Ashe is a utility ADC with global engage and constant slows. She excels at kiting, vision control, and initiating fights from across the map.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive slows enemies with autos. Q stacks then activates for a flurry of arrows. W pokes and slows. E reveals anywhere on map. R is a global stun arrow (longer stun at range). Use W to poke, Q for DPS, R to engage or catch.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Ashe spikes with Kraken Slayer and attack speed. Her utility is strong at all stages. She scales well into late game teamfights.

passive.name: Frost Shot
passive.summary: Auto attacks slow enemies and deal bonus damage to slowed targets.
passive.details: Ashe's attacks slow enemies. Attacks against enemies already slowed by Frost Shot deal bonus damage based on crit chance instead of critting.

abilities.name: Ranger's Focus
abilities.summary: Stack with autos, then activate for rapid-fire attacks.
abilities.details: Passive: Ashe builds Focus stacks with attacks. Active: Consume stacks to gain attack speed and fire a flurry of arrows with each attack.

abilities.name: Volley
abilities.summary: Fire a cone of arrows that slow the first enemies hit.
abilities.details: Ashe fires arrows in a cone, dealing damage and applying Frost Shot slow to the first enemy hit per arrow.

abilities.name: Hawkshot
abilities.summary: Send a hawk anywhere on the map to reveal an area.
abilities.details: Ashe sends a hawk spirit to scout anywhere on the map, revealing terrain as it travels and briefly revealing an area at the destination.

abilities.name: Enchanted Crystal Arrow
abilities.summary: Global stun arrow that stuns longer at greater distance.
abilities.details: Ashe fires a giant arrow globally. The first enemy champion hit takes damage and is stunned; stun duration increases with distance traveled.
